rtxremix.remixMenu.title: Remix menu
rtxremix.settings.title: RTX Remix
rtxremix.enabled.tooltip: Hands the window to the RTX Remix runtime. Takes effect after a restart.
rtxremix.sunPathRotation.tooltip: Turns where the sun and moon rise and set away from due east and west, so shadows do not run along block edges. They still pass straight overhead at noon. 0 is Minecraft's east-west path.
rtxremix.clouds.tooltip: Sends Minecraft's clouds to Remix as geometry, so they are lit by the sun and cast shadows. Follows Minecraft's cloud setting (off, fast or fancy) and cloud distance, capped at 48 chunks.
rtxremix.emissiveIntensity.tooltip: Brightness of glowing texels from a LabPBR resource pack's _s maps. Takes effect when resource packs reload (F3+T).
rtxremix.pomDepth.tooltip: How deep a LabPBR resource pack's height maps (alpha of the _n maps) carve into blocks, through Remix's parallax occlusion mapping. 0 turns it off. Takes effect when resource packs reload (F3+T).
rtxremix.pbrAoStrength.tooltip: How much a LabPBR resource pack's ambient occlusion (blue channel of the _n maps) darkens textures. Remix has no AO input, so it darkens sunlit texels too; 0 turns it off. Takes effect when resource packs reload (F3+T).
rtxremix.subsurfaceScattering.tooltip: Lets light pass through leaves, plants and other texels a LabPBR resource pack marks as subsurface scattering (blue channel of the _s maps). Takes effect when resource packs reload (F3+T).
rtxremix.runtimePath.tooltip: Folder (relative to the game directory) holding the RTX Remix 1.6.1 runtime: d3d9.dll and the .trex folder. Takes effect after a restart.
